critique: The framing SVG does real De Stijl work — the indigo-to-cream outer ledger with its cadmium yellow left column and the paired blue/yellow transverse bars sliding vertically give the illusion that rooms are literally trading dimensions, and the recessed van Doesburg-esque corridor painting at centre is a genuinely witty choice: a perspectival tunnel embedded in a strictly flat grid. But the guinea pig is an 18px, 57%-opacity speck half-masked by a `#11162f` rectangle in the lower right — if the animal was named in the brief it is effectively absent, and even as a private joke it reads as a dust mote rather than a mark, while the borrowed central painting carries more compositional authority than anything the code itself generated.
